raw_request: Rebuild dsh-tui as agent-tui while preserving Cordis services, plugins, lifecycle and rendering boundaries, using an OpenCode serve adaptor as the sole Host integration.
understood_objective: agent-tui independently runs as a Cordis terminal client against OpenCode serve, with typed sessions, SSE streaming, prompt/abort, semantic presentation, asynchronous rendering and preserved input/lifecycle behavior.
acceptance_criteria: agent-tui is the sole public package and CLI entrypoint
OpenCode serve health, sessions, messages, prompt, SSE and abort are verified through the built user entrypoint
Cordis service/plugin/lifecycle and semantic theme/render boundaries remain intact
buffer, stream, refresh and terminal input do not block one another
build, install, restart and real PTY blackbox evidence bind the same source, artifact and environment
assumptions: OpenCode serve is available at the configured endpoint and owns session execution truth
